Bills, Signatures & Attachments

Upload supplier bills, invoices, stock sheets or signatures. Bill date is optional. Select it manually or write a date in the Bill Description; recognised dates are saved for From–To searches.

Upload Bill / Invoice / Stock Document

You can select the date here. If left blank, the app will try to detect a date written in Description.
Example: KTC Invoice 28/08/2026. Recognised dates can auto-fill the bill date.
From–To search uses the saved Bill Date, including dates automatically detected from Bill Description. Undated bills remain available when filters are cleared.

🧾 Bill → Stock Entry

After uploading a bill, review each received item here and post it to Stock. Back-dated bills automatically recalculate all later Opening / Closing balances for that supplier + item. Existing Kitchen Movement is preserved.

Upload/select a bill, then tap Free Auto Read. Free OCR will read the bill where possible. Always review the detected items/quantities before confirming. Manual Bill → Stock remains available.
✨ Free OCR Bill Review
UseBill ItemMatched Stock ItemQtyUnit
Check the detected lines before confirming. Unmatched items are not posted until you select the correct stock item.

This build preserves Stock, Suppliers, Items, Movements, Sales, Bills, Signatures, Catering Orders and Vendor Orders. Use Import All Previous Details whenever you open a newer build or move between devices.

Settings, Private Cloud & Backup

Private cloud sync keeps one master dataset across your devices. A local backup is still recommended.

Restaurant Details

🔐 Private Cloud Sync

Use one private account so the same master inventory is available on your laptop, PC, phone and tablet. Changes are synced to the cloud and protected by your account.

Cloud is not configured. Local data remains on this device until cloud setup is completed.

Backup & Restore

Important: Import All Previous Details safely merges old Suppliers, Items, Stock Entries, Kitchen/Outside Movements, Sales, Bills/Documents, Signatures, Feedback, Catering Orders and Vendor Orders without deleting the current data. This app normally stores data on the current device/browser. To move all your data to another phone, tablet, laptop, or to email/WhatsApp, use Create Portable App With All Data. The downloaded HTML contains a copy of your current inventory, stock entries, movements, suppliers, documents, signatures, feedback and settings. Open that portable HTML on the other device and your data will be imported automatically. Keep a separate JSON backup as an additional safety copy.

Menu Library & Production Planner

Choose from regional menus, Catering A–Z, India Grand National, International Vegetarian, Signature Wedding and Diwali Special collections. Menus are built as attractive multi-course combinations for practical catering. Enter PAX to calculate production quantities, edit them, and send the menu to Catering Order.

Selected Menu

Ingredient guide: Specific dish names are used (for example Onion Sambar, Brinjal Sambar, Dosakaya Pachadi, Dondakaya Vepudu, Ash Gourd & Pumpkin Olan). Ingredient quantities scale automatically with PAX and Buffer. Every number is editable before you use it.

Production guide: Quantities are editable planning defaults, not fixed recipes. Adjust for your portion size, service style and kitchen standard, then save as your own menu.

Stock Entry

For a new stock entry, Opening Qty is filled automatically from that item’s latest previous Closing Qty. Closing Stock = Opening + Received − Kitchen Movement.

Daily Sales

Calculation: VAT = Gross Sales × VAT %; Net / Actual Sales = Gross Sales − VAT. You can change the VAT rate for each day.
